results.title: India conducts successful flight test of indigenous Pralay missile
results.content: The Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) successfully flight-tested the indigenously developed Pralay quasi-ballistic missile from Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Island off the Odisha coast. Conducted as part of user evaluation trials, the test achieved all mission objectives and marks a significant step towards the missile’s induction into the Indian armed forces. Developed by Research Centre Imarat and other DRDO laboratories, Pralay is a key component of India’s indigenous missile development programme.

results.title: Watch: Fire breaks out at Delhi’s New Azadpur; 16 fire units rushed to the spot
results.content: A fire broke out at a commercial establishment in Delhi on Friday, with another blaze reported at a shop in New Azadpur. At least 16 fire units were rushed to the spot. Firefighting operations are underway.

results.title: Watch: India’s Pralay missile passes key test, induction into military nears
results.content: India has successfully test-fired its indigenously developed Pralay quasi-ballistic missile off the Odisha coast. Developed by DRDO, the short-range surface-to-surface missile has a range of 150 to 500 km and can carry conventional warheads weighing up to 1,000 kg. The Defence Ministry said its induction is imminent.
